name: How do I choose the correct wood species and finish for my transition strips?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the correct wood species and finish for my transition strips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the correct wood species and finish involves matching or complementing your existing flooring and home décor. If you have hardwood, it's often best to match the species (e.g., oak to oak) and stain color for a seamless look. Alternatively, you might opt for a contrasting wood or a painted finish to create a deliberate design element. When making this decision, consider the durability of the wood in high-traffic areas and how well the finish will hold up over time. Our team can provide samples and advice based on your current flooring and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a wood species and finish that matches or complements your existing flooring and home décor, considering durability and aesthetic.
